chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad from his father, who raised it (to the Prophet), saying:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever frees a believing slave, Allah will free one part of his body from the Fire for each part of that slave's body. And if she is a female, Allah will free one part of his body from the Fire for every two parts of her body, because the woman is half of the man.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for freeing a believing male versus female slave according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal* establishes a precise, proportional reward for manumission, linking the physical liberation of the slave to the spiritual purification of the owner from Hellfire. The specific mention of women being 'half of a man' reflects the classical juristic understanding of *dhiymah* (blood money) and spiritual merit, where a female slave’s emancipation yields half the reward of a male’s, emphasizing the tangible, bodily nature of the divine recompense.
